theme: दोनों पक्ष का प्रमुख परिचय — Duryodhana names the key leaders of his army
context: Duryodhana is now building a battlefield picture for Sanjaya, naming the important leaders of the Kaurava side. He does not speak in abstract philosophy here; he is describing the military structure and the honor, position, and authority of those standing before Arjuna.
contextHindi: दुर्योधन सैन्य-चित्र को स्पष्ट करता है। वह अपने पक्ष के प्रमुख नायकों का नाम ले रहा है, इसलिए यह श्लोक युद्धभूमि की वास्तविकता को सामने रखता है, न कि कोई आध्यात्मिक सिद्धांत।
sanskritDevanagari:
अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम |
नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते ||१-७||
transliteration:
asmākaṃ tu viśiṣṭā ye tānnibodha dvijottama .
nāyakā mama sainyasya saṃjñārthaṃ tānbravīmi te ||1-7||

wordByWord.meaning: our; belonging to us. It indicates the side Duryodhana is presenting.
but / indeed; it marks a contrast and a turn to the important names.
distinguished, notable, especially important; not ordinary soldiers.
listen carefully / understand; a direct address to Sanjaya.
best of the twice-born; a respectful address to the learned hearer.
leaders, captains; those who direct and embody the army's strength.
of my army; this frames the list as a strategic overview.
for the sake of recognition or identification; he is naming key figures with meaning.
I am speaking; a direct, personal declaration of the list.

spokenHindi: यह श्लोक दुर्योधन की स्मरण-शक्ति और अपने पक्ष की तैयारी को व्यक्त करने का एक साफ़ तरीका है। वह कहता है, ‘द्विजोत्तम, मेरे सैन्य के जो सबसे विशिष्ट तथा प्रमुख नेता हैं, उनके नाम सुनो। मैं उन्हें संज्ञा के लिए बता रहा हूँ।’ यहाँ ध्यान देने वाली बात यह है कि वह सिर्फ़ एक लम्बी सूची नहीं दे रहा; वह अपने सैनिक बल की संरचना, उसके नेतृत्व और उसकी प्रतिष्ठा को समझाना चाहता है। यह श्लोक मन की उत्तेजना, युद्ध की तैयारी और एक-दूसरे को समझाने की भाषा है। इसमें कोई आध्यात्मिक सिद्धांत नहीं है, बल्कि युद्धभूमि का व्यावहारिक विवरण है। इसीलिए हम इसे सिर्फ़ ‘नामों की सूची’ न मानकर, एक घटनाक्रम की दृष्टि से सुनते हैं—एक सेनापति अपने सामने खड़ी सेना की ताकत को पहचानने की कोशिश कर रहा है। जीवन में भी कई बार हम किसी समस्या के सामने उसी तरह अपनी स्थिति को समझते हैं: सबसे पहले उसके मुख्य तत्वों, लोगों और नेतृत्व को पहचानें, फिर निर्णय लें।
clearEnglish: This verse is a strategic introduction to the battlefield. Duryodhana is not making a philosophical statement about the soul or duty; he is naming the important leaders of his side so that the situation can be clearly understood. The word viśiṣṭāḥ points to persons of standing, those who matter in the field. The address dvijottama is respectful and formal, and the phrase saṃjñārthaṃ tells us that the purpose is recognition and orientation: these are the people one must know when assessing the strength of the army. In other words, the verse is not moralizing about warriors; it is establishing a map. The psychological truth is that fear, uncertainty, and emotion often improve when reality is named clearly. In modern life, this is a useful discipline: before reacting to a difficult challenge, identify the actual players, their stakes, and the real structure of the situation instead of relying on vague panic or fantasy.

interpretationPerspectives.label: Text
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The verse names the distinguished leaders of Duryodhana's army and says he is telling them for recognition. It is a battlefield inventory, not a moral verdict on people or a cosmic teaching.

interpretationPerspectives.label: Commentary
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The DLS context treats this as a strategic listing within the epic's martial narration. It clarifies the military and social logic of a warrior's speech, not a modern theory of statecraft.

interpretationPerspectives.label: Inference
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: Duryodhana is making the army's strength visible and significant. That is a reasonable inference from the verse, but it does not mean the Gita endorses his stance; it simply frames the situation he sees.

practicalApplication.label: Name the real leaders
practicalApplication.text: When facing a challenge, identify the actual people, roles, and pressures involved before deciding whether the situation is manageable or overwhelming.

practicalApplication.label: Use clarity instead of panic
practicalApplication.text: Speak the reality of the situation plainly: this reduces the emotional fog that often makes difficult circumstances seem larger than they are.

reflectionQuestion: When a problem feels chaotic, do I first identify the actual people, responsibilities, and pressure points before reacting to the fear of it?
reflectionQuestionHindi: जब कोई समस्या अराजक लगती है, तो क्या मैं पहले वास्तविक लोगों, जिम्मेदारियों और दबावों को पहचानता हूँ, फिर डर के आधार पर प्रतिक्रिया करता हूँ?
